swarm.docs_reader: PayFlow is a fictional digital wallet / money-transfer platform built as a security-training reference app, not a real product. Node20/TS/Express5/Prisma6/Postgres16 backend (argon2id passwords, JWT access+refresh cookies, helmet, rate-limiting); React19/TS/Vite/Tailwind frontend; npm workspaces monorepo. main@v1.0.0-clean-baseline is a frozen 'clean' baseline per details.md section16 (proper authz, validation, parameterized queries, secure hashing, audit logging, security headers, rate limiting, no committed secrets, tests). 18 vuln-* branches each inject one CWE-mapped bug from the clean baseline for a scanner-comparison exercise (documented lifecycle CLEAN->inject->VULNERABLE->scan->FINDING->AI analysis->ROOT CAUSE->FIX->VERIFICATION->CLEAN). demo-script.md documents SonarQube finding 0/18 injected vulns vs AI review finding most of them. .env.example names: DATABASE_URL, TEST_DATABASE_URL, PORT, NODE_ENV, ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET, ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL, REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS, COOKIE_DOMAIN, CORS_ORIGIN. Small early-stage project, Phase1+2 built, Phase3(ops portal/roles)+4 speced not built; 14 backend Jest/Supertest test files, frontend Vitest+RTL.

swarm.history_miner_summary: 19 security-relevant commits (VULN-001..018 + SONAR-DEMO), plus AI vuln-scan findings (two rounds: 717181d, 2647e0d), SonarQube SAST (0/18 detected, style-only), ZAP DAST (missing security headers only), and one worked triage example. Dominant pattern: missing/removed authorization or business-logic validation guards (dropped ownerUserId filter, dropped .positive()/decimal refine, dropped revokeAllRefreshTokensForUser call) that look structurally identical to the safe code and pass functional tests. Secondary pattern: defense-in-depth erosion (token-in-localStorage, CSRF middleware unmounted, CORS wildcard, missing headers) where a second independent layer was silently removed while the primary control still holds.
